title: Pairing code
description: The answer to a pairing request (SPEC.md § 5.2).

code.description: 8 to 32 symbols of 23456789ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ (40 bits at least), in groups of 4 joined by -.

poll.description: Where to poll; unguessable, it gives the token once.

expires.description: Seconds until the code expires: 10 minutes at most.
